about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos, clips and the map run full bleed; type stays inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail); poster is the 1080x1350 map poster, a feed post with an even margin, so no label or title sits on the crop line.
